question: What is the maximum duration of a single meeting room booking in Berlin?
ground_truth_answer: 4 hours (240 minutes); longer workshops are booked by the facility team as several bookings.

question: Can I book a meeting room in Berlin from 10:10 to 10:50?
ground_truth_answer: No, bookings must start and end on a full quarter hour, e.g. 10:00 to 11:00.

question: Can meeting rooms in the Berlin office be booked on Saturdays?
ground_truth_answer: No, only Monday to Friday 07:00-20:00; for weekend events contact the facility team.

question: How far in advance can I book a meeting room in Berlin?
ground_truth_answer: At most 60 days.

question: Why am I not allowed to book the Tempelhof room for a 1:1 customer call?
ground_truth_answer: Big room policy: rooms with 12+ seats need at least 4 attendees; use A1-01 or A1-02 which have the same video system.

question: How long after a meeting with catering can the next booking start?
ground_truth_answer: 15 minutes later at the earliest because of the cleaning buffer.

question: How do I order catering for a meeting in a Berlin meeting room?
ground_truth_answer: Via the catering form in the intranet, at least 2 working days in advance; the booking system does not order catering.

question: When do I have to check in to my meeting room booking in Berlin?
ground_truth_answer: From 5 minutes before until 10 minutes after the start, at the door display or with /room checkin.

question: What happens in Berlin if nobody checks in to a meeting room booking?
ground_truth_answer: The booking is released automatically 10 minutes after the start; the owner gets an email and the facility team is informed.

question: Until when can I cancel my desk booking?
ground_truth_answer: Until 10:00 on the same day.

question: I need to cancel a Berlin meeting room booking that starts in one hour. What can I do?
ground_truth_answer: Own cancellations are only possible until 2 hours before; contact the facility team via #facility-roomie.

question: What does the room id B2-14 mean?
ground_truth_answer: Room number 14 on floor 2 of building B.

question: Which meeting room has an induction loop for hearing aids?
ground_truth_answer: A2-10 (Tempelhof).

question: Where should business rules like durations and limits be defined in our Python services?
ground_truth_answer: Once in a central configuration module (config.py) and imported from there (PY-03).

question: How should I get the current time in business logic?
ground_truth_answer: Inject a clock instead of calling datetime.now(); all datetimes must be timezone-aware (PY-05).

question: May I raise HTTPException in a service class?
ground_truth_answer: No, business logic raises domain exceptions; conversion to HTTP happens in a central handler (PY-06).

question: Which HTTP header do our internal services use for API keys and why not the Authorization header?
ground_truth_answer: X-<Service>-Key (e.g. X-Roomie-Key); the corporate reverse proxy strips the Authorization header.

question: What does an error response of our APIs look like?
ground_truth_answer: {"error": {"code": "<SERVICE>-<status>-<REASON>", "message": ...}}

question: Should a booking that was cancelled be deleted with a DELETE endpoint?
ground_truth_answer: No, resources kept for statistics are soft-deleted; use POST /{id}/cancel instead of DELETE.

question: Which status code should an API return if a request violates a business rule?
How must timestamps be formatted in our APIs?
ground_truth_answer: ISO 8601 with timezone offset; timestamps without offset are rejected with 422; stored and returned in UTC.

question: What do tests for API error cases have to check?
ground_truth_answer: The error code in the response body, not only the HTTP status (TEST-04).

question: What test coverage is required for new code?
ground_truth_answer: At least 80% line coverage (TEST-06).

question: How do I name a branch for a bug fix?
ground_truth_answer: fix/<ticket>-short-name, e.g. fix/WORK-412-naive-datetimes.

question: Who has to approve a merge request that changes the maximum booking duration in config.py?
ground_truth_answer: One team member plus the product owner of the business department (facility management).

question: Is it okay to commit an API key in a test file?
ground_truth_answer: No, secrets must never be committed; only clearly marked local demo keys are allowed (SEC-01).

question: I accidentally pushed a password to the repository. What do I have to do?
ground_truth_answer: Treat it as compromised: rotate it immediately and inform #security; removing the commit is not enough.

question: May I log the meeting title when a booking is created?
ground_truth_answer: No, personal data like meeting titles must not be logged; log the user id and a request id.

question: How long may booking data including the owner be stored?
ground_truth_answer: 12 months, then it has to be anonymised.

question: Can we build a report showing which employees cause the most no-shows?
ground_truth_answer: No, evaluations of individual persons need the approval of the works council; team-level evaluations are allowed.

question: Can I paste production logs into an AI assistant to debug a problem?
ground_truth_answer: No, logs with user ids or other personal data and secrets must not be shared with AI assistants.

question: Are AI agents allowed to push code or deploy on their own?
ground_truth_answer: No, agents only work in a sandbox or feature branch without production credentials, and a human approves every change.

question: My team lead wants a dashboard that ranks colleagues by how often they skip meetings they booked. Can I build that?
ground_truth_answer: Not without the approval of the works council; evaluations of individual persons are not allowed, team-level evaluations are.

question: I reserved a spot in the open space for tomorrow but now I'll work from home. Until when can I drop it without it counting against me?
ground_truth_answer: Desk bookings can be cancelled until 10:00 on the same day; later cancellations count as a no-show.

question: I came to the office at 10:45 and someone else was sitting at the desk I had reserved. Is that allowed?
ground_truth_answer: Yes, desks not checked in by 10:30 are released and can be booked by others.

question: Where do I put my laptop and jacket overnight if I don't have a fixed desk?
ground_truth_answer: Into the permanently assigned lockers on each floor; desks must be left empty.

question: A reviewer complained that my endpoint crashes with a 500 when the end date is before the start date. What should it return instead?
ground_truth_answer: 422 - a business rule violation must never be answered with 500.

question: The firmware of our door displays can't get a bearer token through to the service. How are these devices supposed to authenticate?
ground_truth_answer: With an API key in the custom header X-<Service>-Key (e.g. X-Roomie-Key).

question: Is it okay to just write 15 directly into the overlap check for the cleaning time?
ground_truth_answer: No, business rules like the cleaning buffer must be defined once in config.py and imported (PY-03).

question: My unit test passes in the morning but fails every evening after 8 pm. What did I do wrong?
ground_truth_answer: The test depends on the real current time; inject a fake clock and advance it explicitly (TEST-03, PY-05).

question: Someone pasted our staging token into a public Slack channel. Is it enough to delete the message?
ground_truth_answer: No, the secret is compromised: rotate it immediately and inform #security; secrets must never be shared via Slack.

question: Can I use Copilot with my private GitHub account for work on our services?
ground_truth_answer: No, only tools approved by Information Security may be used; private accounts are not allowed for company work.

question: An agent opened a pull request and wants to merge it itself once CI is green. Is that fine?
ground_truth_answer: No, a human must approve every change; agents must not push, merge or deploy on their own.

question: How long can I look up application logs when I investigate an incident?
ground_truth_answer: 30 days.

question: We're planning a full-day hackathon in the big room. How do we get it for the whole day?
ground_truth_answer: Bookings are limited to 4 hours; the facility team books full days as several consecutive bookings - request at least one week in advance.

question: A partner from another company wants to reserve a room for our joint meeting. How does that work?
ground_truth_answer: Guests cannot book rooms themselves; their host books the room for them.

question: About a third of our team's room bookings never take place. Will anyone notice?
ground_truth_answer: Yes, teams with a no-show rate above 25% are contacted by facility management.

question: Is test_cancel_2 a good name for my new test?
ground_truth_answer: No, test names describe the expected behaviour, e.g. test_late_cancellation_only_for_admins.

question: I want to fix the 500 error for timestamps without timezone. What should be the first thing in my merge request?
ground_truth_answer: A test that reproduces the bug and references the ticket (TEST-07).

question: Do we have to delete booking records after a year?
ground_truth_answer: No, they have to be anonymised after 12 months; deleting is not required if they are anonymised.

question: I want to store the names of everyone invited to a meeting together with the booking. Any concerns?
ground_truth_answer: Yes, data minimisation: a booking system needs the owner and the number of attendees, not their names.

question: Should I write 'Wannsee' or something else when I mention the room in a Jira ticket?
ground_truth_answer: Use the room id (B2-14), names can change.

question: I booked a Berlin meeting room for 14:00. Until when do I have to confirm that the meeting actually takes place?
ground_truth_answer: Check in until 14:10 (10 minutes after the start), earliest from 13:55.

question: Is a 3.5-hour workshop booking in one of our Berlin meeting rooms still allowed?
ground_truth_answer: Yes, bookings in Berlin can last up to 4 hours.

question: Can I still cancel my Berlin room booking myself 90 minutes before the meeting?
ground_truth_answer: No, own cancellations are only possible until 2 hours before the start; contact the facility team.

question: Our new API should use Authorization: Bearer tokens like the API guidelines say, right?
ground_truth_answer: No, the current guidelines (API-04) require an API key in X-<Service>-Key; Bearer was only allowed in the superseded version 3.

question: Should my endpoint answer with 400 Bad Request when a booking violates a business rule?
ground_truth_answer: No, business rule violations return 422 (API-06).

question: If a client sends a timestamp without an offset, can the server just assume Berlin time?
ground_truth_answer: No, timestamps without offset are rejected with 422 (API-07).

question: We want to celebrate our release with 40 people and pizza in the office. Which room do we book in Roomie?
ground_truth_answer: None - this is an event: event spaces are requested via the event request form at least 4 weeks in advance, not in Roomie.

question: How often do I have to change the password of my company account?
ground_truth_answer: Not periodically - only if there is a suspicion that someone else knows it.

question: I need access to the production database to debug WORK-412. How do I get it?
ground_truth_answer: Request temporary production access (max. 8 hours) via the access portal, justified with a ticket.

question: My laptop was stolen on the train, and it had a local .env file with API keys. What do I do?
ground_truth_answer: Call the security hotline immediately (remote lock and wipe), report it to the police, and treat the keys as compromised: rotate them.
